answer: Each agent’s proof crystallises in a glacier-ledger, hard-frozen until epoch-end; auditors fire a narrow signal beam at random hashes to melt and read. A Sybil must carve a fresh crystal for each identity, incurring 1.8 Joules of thaw energy plus the irreversible loss of the old crystal—no parallel melt bath can mass-reforge unique facets. Fake count multiplies the kWh toll.
